description: This file defines the 'Activity' enum in the org.eclipse.hono.auth package, representing various permissions required to access Hono service resources, such as READ, WRITE, and EXECUTE, with a method to get a character code for each activity.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: An enumeration representing different permission activities (READ, WRITE, EXECUTE) required for accessing Hono service resources. Includes a method to obtain a single-character code for each activity.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the first character of the enum constant's name, providing a compact representation of the activity.
